metadata.description: Deploys the TrendMicroOAT_Complete universal parser function (works with old + new OAT data) to the Log Analytics workspace

variables.functionQuery:

//    otherwise parse the `RawData` JSON string the connector preserves (old + new flat data).
| extend _detailDyn = column_ifexists("detail", dynamic(null))
| extend _detailStr = tostring(column_ifexists("detail_s", ""))
| extend _rawData    = tostring(column_ifexists("RawData", ""))
| extend _d = case(isnotnull(_detailDyn), _detailDyn, isnotempty(_detailStr), todynamic(_detailStr), isnotempty(_rawData), todynamic(_rawData), dynamic(null))
// ── Resolve endpoint + filters objects for fallback (legacy data may carry them whole).
| extend _ep = column_ifexists("endpoint", dynamic(null))
| extend _filters = iff(isnotnull(column_ifexists("filters", dynamic(null))), column_ifexists("filters", dynamic(null)), todynamic(tostring(column_ifexists("filters_s", ""))))
| project

    SourceSystem = tostring(column_ifexists("SourceSystem", "")),
    Computer = tostring(column_ifexists("Computer", "")),
    RawData = _rawData,
